import unittest
from roman import RomanConverter

class TestRomanConverter(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_int_to_roman(self):
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.int_to_roman(1), 'I')
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.int_to_roman(4), 'IV')
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.int_to_roman(9), 'IX')
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.int_to_roman(58), 'LVIII')
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.int_to_roman(1994), 'MCMXCIV')
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.int_to_roman(3999), 'MMMCMXCIX')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.int_to_roman(0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.int_to_roman(4000)

    def test_roman_to_int(self):
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.roman_to_int('I'), 1)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.roman_to_int('IV'), 4)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.roman_to_int('IX'), 9)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.roman_to_int('LVIII'), 58)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.roman_to_int('MCMXCIV'), 1994)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.roman_to_int('MMMCMXCIX'), 3999)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.roman_to_int('MMMM')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.roman_to_int('ABC')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.roman_to_int('IIII')

EOF

python3 -m unittest /work/test_roman.py
